capped_volume_input_review.scope: Actual reading of the specified proofs, finite atlas and adjunction normalization, all six determinant regions, source axes, compact minimum principle and fixed-degree extension; not merely confirming that proofs are present.
capped_volume_input_review.intrinsic_identity: For s=||L||^2, epsilon=|t|>0, alpha=A0-log(s+epsilon), chi=s/(s+epsilon), curvature Theta and Chern derivative square D, ddc[-2log(alpha)]=-2chi Theta/alpha + 2(epsilon alpha+s)D/[alpha^2(s+epsilon)^2]. The expression extends smoothly across L=0 for each fixed nonzero t.
capped_volume_input_review.absorption: Let alpha_*=A0-log S and Theta_i<=k_i h0. Positivity follows from alpha_*>=max(1,4 sum k_i). For the holomorphic df lower bound require 2 sum k_i/alpha_*+K_b[1/(2alpha_*)+2/alpha_*^2]<=1/2. The mu bound uses chi(1-chi)<=1/4. Constants come from fixed ambient data and finitely many holomorphic frames.
capped_volume_input_review.pair_triple_quantifiers: For fixed C0 and A0 choose the small-parameter threshold. Pair: after ordering x=s_u/epsilon>=C0^(-1/2), chi_u>=1/(1+sqrt(C0)), y<=C0^(3/2) and alpha_v>=A0+L/2-log(1+C0^(3/2)). Triple: delta=1/(2C0) gives two chi values at least 1/(2C0+1), and the remaining alpha is at least A0+L/3-log(C0^(1/3)+1). These constants do not depend on depth ratios or phases.
capped_volume_input_review.source_and_residue: Keep the original plane representatives x,y and set z=-F/P, so xy=tz exactly. For t=tau^2, (x,y,z)=(tau X,tau Y,XY); alpha_x=A0+L/2-log(1+b_x|X|^2), |t|Q_x and |t|Q_y are bounded below by c/L, including axes, and -dx wedge dy/t=-dX wedge dY. Adjunction residue densities retain all units/Jacobians and have no arbitrary t-dependent rescaling.
capped_volume_input_review.cover_and_order: Fixed ambient finite charts cover a neighborhood of the central fiber. On its compact complement the product section is bounded away from zero, so all sufficiently small fibers lie in the charts. Choose domains, absorption A0, finitely many unit/product constants and the L floor before the final complex-t threshold. No actual KE tensor bound or moving-domain escape is used to create this cover.
capped_volume_input_review.global_and_degree: At the global minimum of r=log(omega^2/Omega_low) on each smooth compact fiber, ddc r=omega-h_low>=0 gives omega^2>=h_low^2>=c Omega_low. This yields a global potential lower bound including axes and all phases. Degree d>=5 and the family/Hermitian metrics are fixed; at most three plane factors are small. With Fubini-Study plane metrics k_i=1/(d-4), alpha_*>=max(1,4d/(d-4)) suffices for positivity, while the frame budget is separate.
